specs.description:
The Luna Products Door/Window Sensor (LP.DW02.345) is designed
for indoor residential and light commercial use. The Door/Window
sensor can be easily mounted on doors and windows, as well as
other devices that open and close. It communicates with Luna and
2GIG Control Panels over 345 MHz frequency. The sensor supports
two loops. Signals are transmitted to the alarm control panel when
the magnet is moved away from or closer to the sensor (loop 2). The
sensor also has an external input (loop 1) that accepts connections
from a Normally Closed (NC) dry contact device. For additional
security the sensor is supervised and is equipped with tamper switch
that sends a tamper signal when the cover is removed.

The Luna Products PIR Motion Detector (LP.PIR02.345) is designed for indoor
residential and light commercial use. The motion detector is a wall-mounted
device with wide angle motion protection, with adjustable sensitivity and pet
immunity up to 55 lbs. It communicates with Luna, 2GIG and Honeywell Control
Panels over 345 MHz frequency. For additional security the motion detector
sensor is supervised and is equipped with tamper switch that sends a tamper
signal when the cover is removed.

specs.description:
The Luna Products Keyfob (LP.KEY02.345) is a 3-button keyfob. The keyfob enables
you to Arm or Disarm Luna and 2GIG Control Panels before entering or exiting your
home or small business. If there is an emergency, you can trigger a panic which will
turn on the siren and causes the panel to call a central monitoring station (if you
have a current monitoring contract). The keyfob is designed to fit on a keychain and
is designed for residential and light commercial use. The key fob provides a
convenient option for the following system operations:
• Arm the system (doors, windows, motions and other sensors)
• Arm the system with no entry delay (if programmed)
• Disarm the system
• Trigger panic alarms

specs.description:
The Luna Products Glass Break Detector (LP.GB01.345) is designed for indoor
residential and light commercial use. The sensor can be easily mounted on the
ceiling or wall and is tamper protected and supervised. It communicates with
Luna, 2GIG and Honeywell Control Panels over 345 MHz frequency. The
maximum detection range is 15 ft (4.57 m) and has a 360° maximum
horizontal sensing angle, with dual stage glass break detection (thud & crash).

The Luna Products Medical Pendant (LP.MED02.345) is a single button pendant.
The pendant is designed to transmit an emergency signal from any location
within the range of the alarm panel. Signals from the pendant will be
transmitted whether the system is armed or disarmed. The pendant is small,
lightweight and waterproof rated to IPX7. It can also be used with the supplied
lanyard or optional wristband. To activate, press and hold the pendant button
for approximately 2 seconds. The Red LED located on the top of the pendant
will light up for approximately 4 seconds to confirm a signal has been sent.
NOTE: Signals will not be received if the pendant is not within range of the control panel.

A fire that goes undetected can cause serious damage in a matter of seconds. Our smoke detector is equipped with sensors that detect fire before the smoke is even noticeable, immediately alerting you and our monitoring team so they can dispatch help.
This sensor uses a built-in wireless transmitter to communicate with the hub. When carbon monoxide is detected, the alarm goes off, and the hub will alert the monitoring team!
